name: Budding gland
description: A gland dug out of the ruins and still working: a lobed sac under a bent duct, one bead of it already forming at the bottom edge. Soft, full and slightly translucent rather than tense — the bead is the whole point, a thing that makes more of itself. Lit the way the roster lights everything: ink outline, body, one highlight up-left, over the plate's old glow.

glyph.description: Plate off, object only — the silhouette a collection shows for an entry not yet met. Baked from the document instead of recovered from the pixels of the baked one.
